feature_contract.goal: Restore entire vanilla unletterboxed title and car-selection menu in 16:9 and 21:9 when the captured desktop intersects only part of the source window.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: LOCAL fixed menu only; preserve the authored 4:3 path, gameplay HUD, F11, ESC, stereo world, SkyGlow, mono theater, wheel input, FFB, DX11 and DXVK.
trace_stages: Original OutRun front-end produces a 16:9 or 21:9 unletterboxed whole client as the native menu source.
R23 GetGameUv captures only the output intersection, while GetGameClientOutputRect supplies the original full game client rectangle.
PlanVisibleCenteredContent recovers the per-fragment UV and authored optical offsets and R23 presents one coherent local menu in both XR eyes.
subcomponents: Preserve full native client aspect and optical coordinates instead of zooming partially sampled pixels into a complete screen.
Preserve exact 4:3 matte crop and full-client fallback while restoring valid left/bottom/corner 16:9 and 21:9 fragment placement.
Cover source/eye optical aspect, stale/invalid capture and reset/desktop negative regressions.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original game front-end capture and client intersection
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Partial native-width menu retains its original pixel scale and source-side position during output-edge clipping.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Local paired-eye menu geometry and projection
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Both eyes use the same native optical source frame and fragment offsets, retaining sampled pixel physical aspect.
Full client and existing 4:3 output behavior are unchanged; invalid/mismatched UV is rejected without optical corruption.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Windows x86 game, x64 host and package
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: The five DX9Ex Active jobs, Domain Isolation, applicable Full Source Impact and native menu smoke succeed at one immutable SHA.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R23 previously calls PlanVisibleCenteredContent only inside if(cropCentered43); vanilla menus use clipped source aspect directly and therefore recenter and enlarge the fragment.
source_trace: Original native unletterboxed UI occupies the full 1920x1080 or 3440x1440 client; moving it across output edges yields clipped source.
GetGameUv and GetGameClientOutputRect have the full intersection required to calculate physical fragment size and original client offset.
R23 old PlanOpticallyCenteredClip uses the clipped fragment aspect to construct the whole XR quad without optical fragment offset, shifting all visible menu items.
diagnosis.root_cause: The validated original-client UV and optical transform existed only in the authored 4:3 branch; native-aspect front-end menu lost positional and physical size provenance when clipped.
alternatives_rejected: FOV asymmetry and per-eye shader projection are unchanged and already use a common tangent plane; changing the capture pixel source without its original optical location cannot restore correct placement.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Use one validated client-origin/captured-UV plan in R23 for both 4:3 and unletterboxed modes, with native clientAspect as the original optical frame only for the latter.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Portable smoke verifies 16:9 left/bottom, 21:9 corner, native full client, binocular physical aspect and bad/stale reset capture; existing 4:3 regressions kept.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R23 LOCAL-fixed stereo only, shared clip/UV and one two-slice image; original D3D9 stereo world, normal HUD and F11 ownership unchanged.

runtime_evidence: No actual Quest3/VDXR or game runtime session performed.
controller_note: C6 bookkeeping is separate from immutable validation-bearing 2f4723e7. Original game source material remains b6e87d4b. The same task had one missing run-record failure and one 4:3-only source verifier repair; these are not independent scored work. Quest3/VDXR not tested.
